controls.label: Color
controls.qualification: Color of a blackbody at the star's temperature; darkening toward the edge from a model atmosphere. The disc itself is unresolved.
controls.notes: The color of a blackbody at the star's published temperature. The darkening toward the edge is the quadratic law Neilson & Lester (2013), A&A 554, A98 compute from spherical ATLAS (SATLAS) model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 3,660 K and log g -0.05 for 15 solar masses (u1 1.110, u2 -0.013); the model atmosphere is extended, and the law reaches zero at 99.6% of the radius, where the disc is drawn dark: a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used. The spin axis's direction on the sky is a display convention.
